name: Wonderland Marketplace
summary: Wonderland Marketplace is a contemporary open-air shopping plaza in Revere, Massachusetts, featuring a practical mix of retail, dining, and essential services including Marshalls, Planet Fitness, 99 Restaurant & Pub, and USPS. This convenient one-stop destination serves the diverse communities north of Boston with everyday shopping needs and family-friendly amenities.
demographics: Wonderland Marketplace serves a diverse, working-class to middle-income demographic in Revere, Massachusetts, with a strong representation of families and value-conscious shoppers. The trade area draws from the densely populated communities north of Boston, including Revere, Chelsea, and East Boston, with visitors typically seeking convenient one-stop shopping for everyday needs. The center attracts a broad age range from young families to seniors, with household incomes ranging from moderate to middle-class levels, reflecting the economic diversity of the greater Revere area.
description: Wonderland Marketplace stands as an essential shopping and dining destination in the heart of Revere, Massachusetts, serving the communities north of Boston with convenient access from Veterans of Foreign Wars Parkway. This contemporary open-air plaza has established itself as a true one-stop destination, anchored by major retailers including Marshalls for value-conscious fashion shoppers and Planet Fitness for health and wellness enthusiasts. The center's diverse tenant mix extends beyond retail to include essential services such as a United States Post Office, making it a practical choice for residents managing their daily errands. Dining options like 99 Restaurant & Pub provide casual family-friendly meals, complementing the center's supermarket anchor that serves as a grocery destination for the surrounding neighborhoods. With its strategic location near the Wonderland MBTA station and strong community presence reflected in over 1,300 Google reviews averaging 4.3 stars, Wonderland Marketplace has become an integral part of the Revere retail landscape, offering the perfect blend of shopping, services, and dining convenience.
